nodes.label: ADR 0149: DSD analysed as 88.2 kHz PCM conversion
nodes.rationale: DSD files are converted to PCM at 88.2 kHz using linear-phase low-pass filters in two stages. Failures without `engine` field are retried once (pre-0.46 JavaScript failures). Adds 'Analysed from DSD' finding to explain ultrasonic noise. Unverified that verdict needs DSD-specific tuning.
